hypotheses.justification: FiniteDimensional.finiteDimensional_submodule supplies finite-dimensionality of U. The instance RCLike.properSpace_submodule gives ProperSpace U, hence complete_of_proper gives CompleteSpace U, and Submodule.HasOrthogonalProjection.ofCompleteSpace supplies the deleted instance. The statement still elaborates and the existing proof works unchanged. This includes U = ⊥ and zero-dimensional E. Both projection hypotheses can be deleted together.
